1
大學士年表一清大學士，沿明舊名，例稱政府，實則國初有議政處以掣其柄，雍正以後，承旨寄信有軍機處，內閣宰輔，名存而已。 新唐、元史表宰相者，備列三公。 清大學士滿、漢兩途，勛高位極，乃以相授。 內閣實權，遠不逮明。 然其品列，皆首文班。 任軍機者，自親王外，其領袖者必大學士，唐、元三公尚不及也。
Grand Secretaries Chronological Table 1. Qing Grand Secretaries kept the Ming title and were routinely called "the government," yet at the dynasty's founding the Council of Princes held the real levers of power; after Yongzheng, drafting and relaying imperial orders passed to the Grand Council, and the Inner Cabinet's chief ministers were grand councilors in name alone. The chancellor tables in the New Tang History and the Yuan History list all three ranks of duke in full. Qing Grand Secretaries were drawn from both Manchu and Han routes; only men of the highest merit and rank received the title of chancellor. The Inner Cabinet's real authority fell far short of what it had been under the Ming. Yet in official rank they still headed the civil service roster. Among those who served on the Grand Council, apart from imperial princes, the leaders had to be Grand Secretaries—a standing that even the three dukes of Tang and Yuan had not attained.

YearGrand SecretaryAssistant Coordinator
First year of the Chongde reign (bingzi)Ganglin (appointed Grand Secretary of the Inner State History Academy in the fifth month); Fan Wencheng (appointed Grand Secretary of the Inner Secretariat Academy in the fifth month); Xifu (appointed Grand Secretary of the Inner Hongwen Academy in the fifth month); Bao Chengxian (appointed Grand Secretary of the Inner Secretariat Academy in the fifth month)
Second year of the Chongde reign (dingchou)Ganglin; Fan Wencheng; Xifu; Bao Chengxian
Third year of the Chongde reign (wuyin)Ganglin; Fan Wencheng; Xifu; Bao Chengxian (changed in the seventh month to Right Participating Administrator of the Board of Personnel)
Fourth year of the Chongde reign (jimao)Ganglin; Fan Wencheng; Xifu
Fifth year of the Chongde reign (gengchen)Ganglin; Fan Wencheng; Xifu
Sixth year of the Chongde reign (xinsi)Ganglin; Fan Wencheng; Xifu
Seventh year of the Chongde reign (renwu)Ganglin; Fan Wencheng; Xifu
Eighth year of the Chongde reign (guiwei)Ganglin; Fan Wencheng; Xifu
First year of the Shunzhi reign (jiashen)Fan Wencheng (dismissed on xinyou day of the eighth month in the first year); Xifu; Ganglin; Ning Wanwo; Feng Quan (summoned by letter on xinchou day in the fifth month); Hong Chengchou (on dingyi day in the sixth month, still serving as Grand Guardian of the Crown Prince and Vice Censor-in-Chief, joined the Inner Academies in assisting with affairs and became Grand Secretary of the Inner Secretariat Academy); Xie Sheng (summoned into the Inner Academies on renwu day in the eighth month)
Second year of the Shunzhi reign (yiyou)Fan Wencheng; Ganglin; Ning Wanwo; Feng Quan; Hong Chengchou (in the intercalary sixth month, sent to pacify and recruit the south and made commander-in-chief of military affairs); Xie Sheng (died on guimao day in the first month); Qi Chongge (became Grand Secretary of the Inner Hongwen Academy on jisi day in the second month); Li Jiantai (former Ming Grand Secretary of the Wenyuan Pavilion; on gengzi day in the third month he was received in audience and comforted by edict; in the twelfth month, on bingwu day, he was dismissed)
Third year of the Shunzhi reign (bingxu)Fan Wencheng; Ganglin; Ning Wanwo; Feng Quan; Hong Chengchou; Qi Chongge; Song Quan (became Grand Secretary of the Inner Hanlin State History Academy on wuchen day in the first month)
Fourth year of the Shunzhi reign (dinghai)Fan Wencheng; Ganglin; Ning Wanwo; Feng Quan; Hong Chengchou (ordered back to the Inner Academies in the tenth month); Qi Chongge; Song Quan
Fifth year of the Shunzhi reign (wuzi)Fan Wencheng; Ganglin; Ning Wanwo; Feng Quan; Hong Chengchou; Qi Chongge; Song Quan
Sixth year of the Shunzhi reign (jichou)Fan Wencheng; Ganglin; Ning Wanwo; Feng Quan; Hong Chengchou (made Junior Tutor and concurrently Grand Tutor to the Crown Prince); Qi Chongge; Song Quan
Seventh year of the Shunzhi reign (gengyin)Fan Wencheng; Ganglin; Ning Wanwo; Feng Quan; Hong Chengchou; Qi Chongge; Song Quan
Eighth year of the Shunzhi reign (xinmao)Fan Wencheng (on yihai day of the intercalary second month, dismissed yet kept in post); Ganglin (on yihai day of the intercalary second month, executed in the marketplace for involvement in Prince Rui's treason plot); Ning Wanwo (transferred to Grand Secretary of the Inner State History Academy on jichou day in the third month); Feng Quan (retired on yichou day of the intercalary second month); Hong Chengchou (put in charge of the Left Censor-in-Chief's affairs on wuchen day of the intercalary second month); Qi Chongge (on yihai day of the intercalary second month, executed in the marketplace for involvement in Prince Rui's treason plot); Song Quan; Xifu (became Grand Secretary of the Inner Hongwen Academy on jichou day in the third month); Chen Tai (became Grand Secretary of the Inner State History Academy on jichou day in the third month, and was dismissed on wuzi day in the seventh month); Chen Mingxia (became Grand Secretary of the Inner Hanlin Hongwen Academy on jihai day in the seventh month); Esehei (became Grand Secretary of the Inner Hanlin State History Academy on dingsi day in the tenth month)
Ninth year of the Shunzhi reign (renchen)Fan Wencheng; Ning Wanwo; Hong Chengchou (in the fifth month, though in mourning for his mother, he still entered service); Song Quan (retired; died on renzi day in the sixth month); Xifu (died in the eleventh month); Chen Mingxia; Esehei; Chen Zhilin (became Grand Secretary of the Inner Hanlin Hongwen Academy on xinyou day in the second month)
Tenth year of the Shunzhi reign (guisi)Fan Wencheng; Ning Wanwo; Hong Chengchou (on dingchou day in the first month, transferred to Grand Secretary of the Inner Hanlin Hongwen Academy; on yiyou day in the fifth month, promoted to Grand Guardian and Grand Preceptor to the Crown Prince, attached to the Inner State History Academy, and made military manager for Huguang, Guangdong, Guangxi, Yunnan, and Guizhou); Chen Mingxia (on dingchou day in the first month, transferred to Grand Secretary of the Inner Hanlin Secretariat Academy; on dingwei day in the second month, acted as Minister of Personnel); Esehei; Chen Zhilin (on dingwei day in the second month, while still Grand Guardian of the Crown Prince, transferred to Minister of Revenue); Gao Eryan (while still Grand Guardian of the Crown Prince, became Grand Secretary of the Inner Hanlin Hongwen Academy; on wuzi day in the third month took illness leave; on dingyou day in the sixth month retired because of illness); Feng Quan (on guisi day in the third month, retained his original office as Grand Secretary of the Hongwen Academy); Tuhai (became Grand Secretary of the Inner Hanlin Hongwen Academy on dingwei day in the fourth month); Cheng Kegong (became Grand Secretary of the Inner Hanlin Secretariat Academy on bingyin day in the intercalary sixth month); Zhang Duan (became Grand Secretary of the Inner Hanlin State History Academy on bingyin day in the intercalary sixth month); Liu Zhengzong (became Grand Secretary of the Inner Hanlin Hongwen Academy on bingyin day in the intercalary sixth month; on bingchen day in the eleventh month was made Grand Guardian of the Crown Prince and put in charge of the Board of Personnel); Lü Gong (became Grand Secretary of the Inner Hanlin Hongwen Academy in the twelfth month)
Eleventh year of the Shunzhi reign (jiawu)Fan Wencheng (on renwu day in the eighth month, made Junior Guardian and Grand Guardian of the Crown Prince; on jichou day in the ninth month, Grand Tutor and Grand Preceptor to the Crown Prince; relieved because of illness); Ning Wanwo (made Grand Guardian of the Crown Prince on renwu day in the eighth month); Hong Chengchou; Chen Mingxia (executed in the marketplace on xinchou day in the third month); Esehei (made Grand Guardian of the Crown Prince on renwu day in the eighth month); Feng Quan (demoted three grades on yisi day in the fifth month); Tuhai; Cheng Kegong (demoted two grades on yisi day in the fifth month); Zhang Duan (granted leave; died in the sixth month); Liu Zhengzong; Lü Gong (demoted two grades on yisi day in the fifth month); Jin Zhijun (became Grand Secretary of the Inner Hanlin State History Academy on bingyin day in the second month); Jiang Hede (became Grand Secretary of the Inner Hanlin State History Academy on gengyin day in the third month); Wang Yongji (became Grand Secretary of the Inner Hanlin Secretariat Academy on dinghai day in the fourth month, and was dismissed and transferred on jiaxu day in the eighth month); Dang Chongya (became Grand Secretary of the Inner Hanlin State History Academy on bingwu day in the fifth month); Fu Yijian (became Grand Secretary of the Inner Hanlin Secretariat Academy on gengchen day in the eighth month)
Twelfth year of the Shunzhi reign (yiwei)Ning Wanwo (on xinyou day in the second month, made Junior Guardian and Grand Guardian of the Crown Prince); Hong Chengchou; Esehei; Feng Quan (on yimao day in the fourth month, made Junior Preceptor and Grand Preceptor to the Crown Prince); Tuhai (made Grand Guardian of the Crown Prince on xinyou day in the second month); Cheng Kegong (made Grand Guardian of the Crown Prince on xinyou day in the second month); Liu Zhengzong (on yimao day in the fourth month, made Junior Guardian and Grand Guardian of the Crown Prince); Jin Zhijun (on yimao day in the fourth month, made Junior Tutor and Grand Tutor to the Crown Prince); Jiang Hede (made Grand Guardian of the Crown Prince on xinyou day in the second month); Dang Chongya (on dingsi day in the second month, made Grand Guardian and Grand Tutor to the Crown Prince, then relieved on account of illness); Fu Yijian (made Grand Guardian of the Crown Prince on xinyou day in the second month); Lü Gong (made Grand Guardian of the Crown Prince on xinyou day in the second month, then relieved on account of illness on renxu day in the second month while holding that rank); Bahana (on xinyou day in the second month, made Grand Guardian and Grand Guardian of the Crown Prince; on gengzi day in the fifth month became Grand Secretary of the Inner Hanlin Hongwen Academy); Cheke (on xinyou day in the second month, made Junior Guardian and Grand Guardian of the Crown Prince); Chen Zhilin (on gengchen day in the second month, became Grand Secretary of the Inner Hanlin Hongwen Academy; on yimao day in the fourth month, made Junior Guardian and Grand Guardian of the Crown Prince); Wang Yongji (became Grand Secretary of the Inner Hanlin State History Academy on gengchen day in the second month)
Thirteenth year of the Shunzhi reign (bingshen)Ning Wanwo; Hong Chengchou; Esehei; Feng Quan (on jimao day in the second month, made Grand Guardian and Grand Preceptor to the Crown Prince and retired); Tuhai; Cheng Kegong; Liu Zhengzong; Jin Zhijun; Jiang Hede; Fu Yijian; Cheke (on xinsi day in the sixth month, concurrently put in charge of the Board of Revenue); Chen Zhilin (dismissed on yiwei day in the third month and sent to Shengjing with his original rank; on guimao day in the tenth month, ordered back to the capital and into a banner); Wang Yongji; Bahana
Fourteenth year of the Shunzhi reign (dingyou)Ning Wanwo; Hong Chengchou; Esehei; Tuhai; Cheng Kegong; Liu Zhengzong; Jin Zhijun; Jiang Hede; Fu Yijian; Cheke; Wang Yongji; Bahana

Fifty-first year of the Qianlong reign, bingwuAgui; Ji Huang; Wumitai (died on gengchen day in the intercalary seventh month); Liang Guozhi (died on renzi day in the twelfth month); Heshen (on gengyin day in the intercalary seventh month, made Grand Secretary of the Wenhua Hall, concurrently Minister of Personnel, and placed in charge of Revenue and Personnel)Fuk'anggan (in the seventh month, appointed Assistant Grand Secretary while serving as Minister of Personnel, remaining as Governor-General of Shaanxi and Gansu; in the ninth month, recalled); Liu Yong
Fifty-second year of the Qianlong reign, dingweiAgui; Ji Huang; Heshen; Wang Jie (filled a Grand Secretary post on dinghai day in the first month; on guisi day, made Grand Secretary of the Dongge Pavilion, concurrently Minister of Rites, and placed in charge of the Ministry of Rites)Fuk'anggan (in the eighth month appointed general to suppress the Taiwan rebel Lin Shuangwen)
Fifty-third year of the Qianlong reign, wushenAgui; Ji Huang; Heshen; Wang JieFuk'anggan (acting Governor-General of Fujian and Zhejiang in the tenth month); Liu Yong
Fifty-fourth year of the Qianlong reign, jiyouAgui; Ji Huang; Heshen; Wang JieFuk'anggan (transferred to Governor-General of Guangdong and Guangxi in the first month); Liu Yong (demoted on yichou day in the third month)
Fifty-fifth year of the Qianlong reign, gengxuAgui; Ji Huang; Heshen; Wang Jie (promoted to Grand Guardian to the Crown Prince in the eleventh month)Fuk'anggan (in the eleventh month appointed general for the Gurkha campaign)
Fifty-sixth year of the Qianlong reign, xinhaiAgui; Ji Huang; Heshen; Wang JieFuk'anggan; Peng Yuanrui (dismissed on xinwei day in the fourth month); Sun Shiyi (on xinwei day in the fourth month, appointed Assistant Grand Secretary while serving as Minister of Personnel)
Fifty-seventh year of the Qianlong reign, renziAgui; Ji Huang; Heshen; Wang Jie; Fuk'anggan (appointed Grand Secretary on guiyou day in the eighth month; on wuzi day made Grand Secretary of the Wuying Hall, concurrently Minister of Personnel; in the third month promoted to Grand General); Sun Shiyi (appointed Grand Secretary on guiyou day in the eighth month; on wuzi day made Grand Secretary of the Wenyuan Pavilion, concurrently Minister of Rites)
Fifty-eighth year of the Qianlong reign (in the fourth month of guichou, removed as Grand Secretary while retaining the concurrent ministerial rank)Agui; Ji Huang; Heshen; Wang JieFuk'anggan (transferred to Governor-General of Yunnan and Guizhou in the seventh month); Sun Shiyi
Fifty-ninth year of the Qianlong reign, jiayinAgui; Ji Huang (died on bingwu day in the seventh month); Heshen; Wang JieFuk'anggan; Sun Shiyi (acting Governor-General of Sichuan in the third month)
Sixtieth year of the Qianlong reign, yimaoAgui; Heshen; Wang JieFuk'anggan; Sun Shiyi
